result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: addGuests.handler.ts wraps sendAddGuestsEmails in try/catch that only does console.log('Error sending AddGuestsEmails'), then returns { message: 'Guests added' }. So attendees are persisted and calendar updated, but email delivery failures are silently swallowed with a success response and no retry. The mechanism described matches the code exactly; whether maintainers deem it intentional fire-and-forget is debatable, but the described behavior is real.
